The Telugu verses of the poet Vemana, sharp sayings against caste, idolatry and hypocrisy, with C. P. Brown’s English translation, in the reprint of 1911.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Verses Of Vemana · Charles Philip Brown · 1911, 232 scanned pages. First published 1829, this reprint 1911; Charles Philip Brown died 1884; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
